originality.rationale: Primary full text of Sobolewski–Ulas 2023, especially Problem 7.2 and Proposition 7.3, does not contain a uniform odd-color bound on the first three-square obstruction or its sharp value 103. Gawron–Miska–Ulas 2017 addresses the generating product and special valuation families, not this sharp global odd-color extremum. Dedicated semantic mathematical-record queries and comparison against accessible prior claims found no covering result; risk of an unindexed equivalent is explicitly retained.

value.rationale: Determines the sharp natural least three-square obstruction index uniformly for all odd color counts of colored binary partitions; constructs a concrete extremizer and a reproducible residue-class certificate. Motivated by the general parameter question in Sobolewski–Ulas Problem 7.2. Not an arbitrary finite interval or mere restatement of a standard congruence.
